en.title: Evaluate scientific evidence
en.description: Examine claims, confounders, bias, and the strength of scientific evidence.
tasks: Examine claims, confounders, bias, and the strength of scientific evidence.
prerequisites: Source papers or study descriptions; core analysis does not require network access.
en.example: Use scientific-critical-thinking. Evaluate this study’s claim and explain which design choices weaken causal interpretation.
en.expectedResult: A structured evidence critique with assumptions and unanswered questions.
limitations: Optional diagrams refer to a separate scientific-schematics Skill and OpenRouter credentials, not bundled here.

zh.title: 评估科学证据
zh.description: 检查科学主张、混杂因素、偏差与证据强度。
tasks: 检查科学主张、混杂因素、偏差与证据强度。
prerequisites: 论文原文或研究说明；核心分析不要求联网。
zh.example: 请使用 scientific-critical-thinking：评估此研究的主张，解释哪些设计选择削弱了因果解释。
zh.expectedResult: 结构化证据评述，列出假设和未解决问题。
limitations: 可选图示依赖独立 scientific-schematics Skill 与 OpenRouter 凭据，本包未包含。
